propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria as plain bullets instead of Acceptance Criteria checkboxes, making them invisible to AC item counting and unable to carry operator attestation tags.

The migration script must convert Success Criteria bullet points to Acceptance Criteria checkbox items and merge them into existing AC sections, requiring order-agnostic rewriting to avoid duplication and data corruption.

Non-closed tickets (3 total: 2 open, 1 in_progress) can be migrated safely because none are actively claimed; their plan-review attestations will correctly go stale due to material fingerprint changes.

The dry-run exposed an order-sensitivity defect where 97 of 104 affected tickets had SC preceding AC, causing the initial implementation to duplicate both headings and checklist items; this was fixed by replacing hand-assembled slice logic with an order-agnostic helper.
